findings.description: Payment amount can become negative when a coupon exceeds the order subtotal (Subtotal: $50, Coupon: $75, Result: -$25). Invariant violated: inv-01 (payment amount must never be negative).
findings.evidence: checkoutlab/app/services/checkout.py:110: final_total = subtotal - discount_amount does not floor at Decimal('0.00')
findings.suggested_repair: Add max(Decimal('0.00'), subtotal - discount_amount) floor guard.

summary: 1 critical invariant violation detected and resolved.
